targets: your front row, top to bottom; the back row if the front row is empty (the sim's ReleaseEclipse)

blackSun.rule: 180 px right of and 380 px above the feet point of your front row's middle slot (600, 562) in the 1440x900 fight

comets.launch: the first target's comet leaves on Release + 1; each next target's comet leaves on the frame the one before it hits
comets.flight: its orb goes in a straight line from the black sun's centre to 2 px above his feet point: on launch + k - 1 it is at t = k / fallFrames for k = 1 to fallFrames - 1, each position rounded half up to a whole pixel, floor(v + 0.5), and it hits on launch + fallFrames - 1
comets.draw: over every fighter, before the black sun, so it leaves from behind the disc

eachTarget: eclipse_wait_under from Release + 1 until his comet hits
eclipse_shadowN_under (N = his fall frames) over the wait, from his comet's launch
eclipse_hit_behind and eclipse_hit_front from the hit, 14 frames

rim.note: on each target's own outline, behind him

blackSunTimeline: eclipse_sun_launch_over on each later comet's launch
eclipse_sun_loop_over on the other frames until the last comet hits
eclipse_sun_out_over from the frame after the last hit
hud: HP bars stay on top of every layer
